# Bendorithm 1.0.0 Beta

First public evaluation release of Bendorithm, labelled Beta while under testing: drawing, bending programs, project management and machine setup.

- CAD measurements: Linear, Aligned, Angle and Radius, defining-point visibility and measurements that follow drawing zoom.
- Object snap choices for endpoints, midpoints, intersections and nearest points, with clearer snap feedback.
- Editing and selection in the current supported view, model clipboard actions and undo/redo; calculated and checked states remain separate.
- Copper starter profiles, clearer drawing setup, and refreshed project creation and navigation.
- Projects use metadata catalog loading, 48 projects per page and previews for the displayed page.
- One Settings workspace for machine profiles, tools, travel calibration, component outlines, technology tables, drawing defaults and project storage.
- Refined PDF setup layout, full-profile framing, and clearly named BEP/PDF Batch outputs. Export readiness still requires the appropriate complete check.
- Improved English, Arabic, German, French and Italian presentation, including right-to-left tables and navigation.
- At desktop startup, available updates download automatically and are verified. Opening the installer requires explicit approval for the displayed version. Save work and close Bendorithm before continuing in setup; projects and licensing records are retained.

Windows x64 requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The update package has a version-bound updater signature; no Authenticode publisher certificate is configured. Simulation and collision checks cover supported machine geometry and sampled positions; verify the real machine setup before production.
